info.name: Grid Status API Info Query Data API

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: ID of the dataset (for example ercot_spp_day_ahead_hourly).

params.name: start_time
params.description: Start of the time range filter on the dataset's time index column (ISO 8601). Rows on or after this time are returned.

params.name: end_time
params.description: End of the time range filter on the dataset's time index column (ISO 8601). Rows before this time are returned.

params.name: time
params.description: Point-in-time filter. Accepts 'latest' or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Cannot be combined with start_time or end_time.

params.name: time_comparison
params.description: Comparison operator used when filtering by time.

params.name: publish_time
params.description: Filter based on the dataset's publish time column.

params.name: publish_time_start
params.description: Start of a publish-time range filter.

params.name: publish_time_end
params.description: End of a publish-time range filter.

params.name: filter_column
params.description: The column to filter results by (for example location).

params.name: filter_value
params.description: The value to filter results by.

params.name: filter_operator
params.description: Operator applied between filter_column and filter_value.

params.name: columns
params.description: Comma separated list of columns to return. Defaults to all columns.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return across all pages.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of results to return.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return in a single page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for cursor-based pagination.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone used when interpreting timezone-naive timestamps and when resampling to frequencies of one day or longer.

params.name: resample_frequency
params.description: Frequency to resample the data to, from '1 minute' through '1 year' (for example '5 minutes', '1 hour', '1 day', '1 month').

params.name: resample_by
params.description: Comma separated list of columns to group by before resampling.

params.name: resample_function
params.description: Aggregation function used when resampling.

params.name: return_format
params.description: The return format of the response.

params.name: json_schema
params.description: Shape of the JSON response.

params.name: download
params.description: Whether to return the result as a file download.

items.docs: Query a dataset and return matching rows as JSON or CSV. Example dataset IDs include ercot_spp_day_ahead_hourly (ERCOT day-ahead settlement point prices), ercot_fuel_mix, ercot_as_prices, caiso_load, caiso_lmp_real_time_5_min, and pjm_lmp_real_time_5_min. Pass the X-Stream true request header to stream JSON rows from a server-side cursor instead of buffering the whole result (JSON only); in streaming mode read pagination from the JSON meta.hasNextPage and meta.cursor fields.

info.name: Query a dataset by column value

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: ID of the dataset (for example ercot_spp_day_ahead_hourly).

params.name: filter_column_id
params.description: The column to filter by.

params.name: filter_value_path
params.description: The value to filter the column by.

params.name: return_format
params.description: The return format of the response.

items.docs: Shortcut form of the query endpoint that filters by a single column value in the path (for example a location or settlement point). Accepts the same time-range, resampling, pagination, and format query parameters as the main query endpoint.
